mapper.select: select la.id agreement_id, la.apartment_id, la.room_id, ai.name apartment_name, ri.room_number, (select gi.url from graph_info gi where gi.item_type = 2 and gi.item_id = la.room_id and gi.is_deleted = 0 order by gi.id limit 1) image_url, concat(ifnull(ai.province_name, ''), ifnull(ai.city_name, ''), ifnull(ai.district_name, ''), ifnull(ai.address_detail, '')) address, la.rent, la.lease_start_date, la.lease_end_date from lease_agreement la join apartment_info ai on ai.id = la.apartment_id and ai.is_deleted = 0 join room_info ri on ri.id = la.room_id and ri.is_deleted = 0 where la.phone = #{phone} and la.status in (1 , 2 , 7) and la.is_deleted = 0 order by field(la.status, 2, 1, 7), la.update_time desc limit 1
select count(*) from tenant_bill where user_id = #{userId} and billing_period = #{billingPeriod} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: insert into tenant_bill(user_id, agreement_id, room_id, bill_type, amount, billing_period, due_date, status, create_time, is_deleted) values (#{userId}, #{agreementId}, #{roomId}, #{billType}, #{amount}, #{billingPeriod}, #{dueDate}, 0, now(), 0)
mapper.select: select id, bill_type, case bill_type when 1 then '房租' when 2 then '电费' when 3 then '水费' else '其他' end bill_type_name, amount, billing_period, due_date, status, paid_time, trade_no from tenant_bill where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: update tenant_bill set status = 1, paid_time = now(), trade_no = #{tradeNo}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 0 and is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: insert into repair_order(user_id, agreement_id, room_id, description, contact_phone, status, create_time, is_deleted) values (#{userId}, #{agreementId}, #{roomId}, #{description}, #{contactPhone}, 0, now(), 0)
mapper.select: select ro.id, ai.name apartment_name, ri.room_number, ro.description, ro.contact_phone, ro.status, case ro.status when 0 then '待受理' when 1 then '处理中' when 2 then '已完成' else '已取消' end status_name, ro.create_time, ro.update_time from repair_order ro left join lease_agreement la on la.id = ro.agreement_id left join apartment_info ai on ai.id = la.apartment_id left join room_info ri on ri.id = ro.room_id where ro.user_id = #{userId} and ro.is_deleted = 0 order by ro.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into community_post(user_id, title, content, like_count, comment_count, status, create_time, is_deleted) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, 0, 1, now(), 0)
mapper.select: select cp.id, cp.user_id, ui.nickname, ui.avatar_url, cp.title, cp.content, cp.like_count, cp.comment_count, cp.create_time from community_post cp left join user_info ui on ui.id = cp.user_id where cp.status = 1 and cp.is_deleted = 0 order by cp.create_time desc limit 100
mapper.update: update community_post set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = #{id} and status = 1 and is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: insert into user_message(user_id, title, content, message_type, is_read, biz_id, create_time, is_deleted) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{messageType}, 0, #{bizId}, now(), 0)
mapper.select: select id, title, content, message_type, is_read, biz_id, create_time from user_message where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0 order by is_read, create_time desc limit 100
select count(*) from user_message where user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0 and is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: update user_message set is_read = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0
update user_message set is_read = 1, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0 and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from community_post_like where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into community_post_like(post_id, user_id, create_time, is_deleted) values (#{postId}, #{userId}, now(), 0)
mapper.delete: delete from community_post_like where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update community_post set like_count = case when like_count > 0 then like_count - 1 else 0 end where id = #{id} and status = 1 and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select cp.id, cp.user_id, ui.nickname, ui.avatar_url, cp.title, cp.content, cp.like_count, cp.comment_count, cp.create_time, (select count(*) from community_post_like cpl where cpl.post_id = cp.id and cpl.user_id = #{userId}) liked_by_me from community_post cp left join user_info ui on ui.id = cp.user_id and ui.is_deleted = 0 where cp.status = 1 and cp.is_deleted = 0 order by cp.create_time desc limit #{offset}, #{size}
select count(*) from community_post where status = 1 and is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: update community_post set is_deleted = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, ui.nickname, ui.avatar_url, c.content, c.create_time from community_post_comment c left join user_info ui on ui.id = c.user_id and ui.is_deleted = 0 where c.post_id = #{postId} and c.is_deleted = 0 order by c.create_time desc limit 100
mapper.insert: insert into community_post_comment(post_id, user_id, content, create_time, is_deleted) values (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, now(), 0)
mapper.update: update community_post set comment_count = comment_count + 1 where id = #{postId} and is_deleted = 0
update community_post set comment_count = case when comment_count > 0 then comment_count - 1 else 0 end where id = #{postId} and is_deleted = 0
